props.title: Why Does Hot Stone Massage Feel Different?
props.text: Hot Stone Massage combines traditional massage techniques with smooth heated basalt stones to create a deeply relaxing treatment. The warmth allows muscles to soften before deeper massage techniques are applied, making it easier to release tension without excessive pressure. This treatment is often chosen by guests seeking both physical relaxation and a calming wellness experience.

items.question: Are the stones very hot?
items.answer: No. At Spa Bali Moon, the basalt stones for hot stone massage are heated to a comfortable therapeutic temperature and always tested before being placed on the body. Your therapist checks the temperature throughout the session and adjusts the warmth to your comfort level, so tell them if anything feels too warm.

items.question: What type of stones are used?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon uses smooth basalt stones for Hot Stone Massage because basalt naturally retains heat for longer, spreading warmth evenly through the massage. Larger stones are generally used on broader areas and smaller ones for focused warmth, with common placements on the back, shoulders, neck, legs, arms, hands and feet.

items.question: Is Hot Stone Massage better than a regular massage?
items.answer: Neither is better; they offer different experiences. A regular massage relies entirely on manual techniques, while Hot Stone Massage at Spa Bali Moon combines massage with heated basalt stones, so muscles soften before deeper work begins and tension releases without excessive pressure. It suits guests who prefer warmth to stronger pressure.

items.question: Can this treatment help after travelling?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests choose Hot Stone Massage at Spa Bali Moon after long flights, sightseeing or active holidays, because the warmth of the heated basalt stones helps ease muscular tension and encourages relaxation. Sessions start at IDR 250.000 per person for 1 hour, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can I receive Hot Stone Massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon therapists provide Hot Stone Massage as a home service at villas and hotels throughout Seminyak and nearby areas, bringing all the necessary equipment for a comfortable treatment. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist to the usual price, from IDR 250.000 per person for 1 hour. Book on WhatsApp.

items.question: What is a hot stone massage?
items.answer: Hot stone massage is a full-body massage that uses smooth, heated basalt stones placed on selected areas of the body alongside massage techniques. The warmth helps relax the muscles while the massage creates a deeper sense of relaxation. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, sessions are 1 hour, 1.5 hours or 2 hours.
